plugins.name: agentprime
plugins.description: Check your lockfiles against every published advisory (/agentprime:check, /agentprime:watch, /agentprime:cve), and find out whether an Advisory affects your App: resolves a CVE, GHSA, advisory link or pasted post, analyses it, and ends in a Verdict with file:line evidence.
